observations: Photo 0 shows a collage of five views of a silver and black automotive alternator with visible copper windings and a ribbed pulley.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the same alternator from a side angle, placed on a wooden surface with boxes in the background.
The alternator has a silver aluminum housing, black plastic fan and pulley, and visible red copper windings through the cooling fins.
No brand or model markings are visible on the alternator in either photo.
The seller claims it is a Mercedes-Benz alternator, but no Mercedes-Benz logo or part number is visible in the photos.
The watermark 'FCHISOM POSTED ON JIJI' is present on both photos.
